inventory.visualPurpose: Secretory pathway with vesicle traffic directions
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Endomembrane flow map: nucleus/RER → ERGIC → Golgi (cis→trans) → secretory vesicles/plasma membrane (exocytosis), clathrin/AP adaptin routes to endosomes/lysosomes, COPI retrograde, COPII anterograde

inventory.sourceBook: First Aid for the USMLE Step 1 2026
inventory.visualPurpose: EM patterns of RER and Golgi
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Two EMs: RER with studded ribosomes arrays, Golgi stacked cisternae — the diagnostic ultrastructure for each organelle

notes: Both visuals are original KYP redraws: the secretory-pathway map preserves every arrow and coat of the source figure (COPII anterograde, COPI retrograde Golgi→Golgi and cis→ER, clathrin routes to lysosomes and early endosomes, LDL receptor-mediated endocytosis, membrane recycling); the RER-vs-Golgi EM comparison preserves the diagnostic ultrastructure (ribosome-studded cisternae vs smooth stacked saccules with vesicles).
